description: The W55 hostile fixture: one issued, tax-disabled invoice whose patient and item carry every character class the legacy hand-built CSV template could not survive — a quote and a comma in the name (O"Neil, Bob, the S6 layout breaker), a leading + in the e-mail and = in the description (formula-injection vectors),
usage: Seed block first (patients, appointments, invoices, invoice_items), then POST /api/quickbooks-export with request. Its window (7 Aug 2025, created_at) contains no other fixture's issued invoice. The invoice-email endpoint is driven with requests[0] and legacy_inputs.invoice_emails[0] as the unescaped byte reference (the W56 escaping case).

contract.invoices_csv: expected old-vs-new diff (W55, the S6 escaping only — the numerics and dates agree): buildInvoicesCsv(legacy_inputs.export_invoices, request) writes the row "8/7/2025","O"Neil, Bob","+15550100@example.com","INV-00000004","=cmd|' /C calc'!A0",1,5,5,Y,0,5,"USD" — the unescaped quote and comma in the name split the Customer cell across two columns (13 fields instead of 12) and the = cells open as spreadsheet formulas. The endpoint writes the fixed 12-cell row "8/7/2025","O""Neil, Bob","'+15550100@example.com","INV-00000004","'=cmd|' /C calc'!A0",1,5,5,Y,0,5,"USD": the name quote doubled, the + and = cells single-quoted. Date 8/7/2025, INV-00000004, the numerics 1, 5, 5, the unquoted Y/0/5 and the quoted "USD" are byte-identical on both sides (tax OFF, so the legacy's repeated invoice-level 0/5 equals the endpoint's per-line 0/5 here).
contract.invoice_email: expected old-vs-new diff (W56, the S10 escaping only — five replacements, & < > " '): buildInvoiceHtml(legacy_inputs.invoice_emails[0]) interpolates the phone , the address , the reason =SUM(1,2)*cmd|' /C calc'!A0 and the name O"Neil, raw into the HTML; the ported email-invoice builder emits the same text with & < > " and ' escaped (so the name cell reads O"Neil, Bob and the reason carries ' where the legacy wrote '). The subject, the Email cell (+15550100@example.com has no escapable character), the totals block 5.00 / 0 Outstanding, every CSS byte and every other interpolation are byte-identical.
contract.seeding: line_total, subtotal, tax_amount and total follow from the schema triggers (tax_enabled false forces tax_amount 0 even though the line is taxable); the seed block omits those columns.
